meta.stage21_note: Stage 2.1: category results come from the place category field only, never from substring-matching stop names. Station browsing is the 9 hub stations only. Shopping Centre is 13 entries (SmartCentres Oakville and South Oakville Centre separate; Entertainment Centrum = Centrum, listed once). Community Centre is Town centres only. Library is OPL full branches only. Schools are in search since the 2026-10-28 geocoding pass (74 places; the 7 verified schools >400 m are included with a walking-distance label per user decision 2026-10-28). Large Parks are main-entrance mapped; Gairloch Gardens is excluded (nearest OT stop 1,055 m). Static package still ends 2026-10-31 (ArcGIS zip MD5 unchanged 2026-10-28).
meta.stage21_followup: 2026-10-28 follow-up: Asian Supermarket and Specialty Grocery merged into one category 'specialtyasian' (Asian & Specialty Grocery). School category was deleted for now at that time (the single Gladys Speers prototype destination was removed; prototype list 10 -> 9), then RESTORED by the 2026-10-28 Nominatim geocoding pass (build_schools.py): all 74 geocoded schools are School places. User decision 2026-10-28: the 7 verified schools >400 m from a stop are INCLUDED with an explicit walking-distance label (longWalk=True, walkFromStop_m = true distance) and must never be dropped by a re-run; 0 unresolved.
meta.schools_note: Schools geocoded via OSM Nominatim (see schools-geocoded.json): 74 School places in total (all 74 research schools; 7 with nearest stop >400 m are included with an explicit walking-distance label per user decision 2026-10-28; 0 added by this run), 0 unresolved (not added, never guessed).
meta.street_rule: User decision 2026-10-29: mapping rule is STREET (routed-foot) distance, not straight-line. stop.distance_m in places.json is the routed-foot street distance from street-audit.json (230/230 measured, coordinates only). Threshold stays 400 m, but over-400 m street places are NOT excluded: the 24 places with street >400 m and straight <=400 m carry the distance in their note field ('Street walk {m} m from nearest stop'), and the 7 longWalk schools carry it in walkFromStop_m (longWalk label). Longo's 338 Dundas St E was CORRECTED 2026-10-29: its old placeholder coordinates wrongly mapped it to Kerr St stop 870 (2,891 m street); Nominatim-verified coordinates 43.4883376, -79.7175689 (OSM way 27500951) remap it to Trafalgar + Dundas stop 1657, 151 m straight / 336 m street. Re-run order: build_stage21.py -> build_schools.py -> apply_street_rule.py (this script is idempotent).
